latest_release.body:
Back with 1.0.1, bringing editor improvements and a bunch of bug fixes:

- Godot-JVM now works with every Godot 4.7 release, not only 4.7.2.
- Build Release now also builds the debug jars, so an editor doing a release export is aware of the scripts.
- Build on Run is now a simple on/off toggle (never or always). Ctrl+click (Cmd+click on macOS) a play button to build first anyway.
- The "modified since the last build" warning on nodes now compares file content: saving a script without changes or reverting an edit no longer shows it.
- Split dependencies now live once in `jvm/dependencies/`, shared by debug and release builds.
- New `godotGameRuntimeOnly` and `godotSplitRuntimeOnly` dependency configurations, for libraries needed at runtime only.
- Multi-release dependencies now load their right classes, and dependencies registering the same service all stay registered.
- The embedded JRE is now generated from the project's Java toolchain, into the Godot project's `jvm` directory. This fixes the "directory already exists" error and the wrong-architecture JRE on Apple Silicon Macs. `outputDir` now takes a directory (`outputDir = file("…")`).
- Core types fixed and synced with current Godot, with the missing `VariantArray` and `Dictionary` methods added.
- Fix passing `null` to registered functions.
- Fix enums used as exported subtypes.
- Fix registered members named after Kotlin keywords.
- Many minor bug fixes.

```kotlin
plugins {
    id("com.utopia-rise.godot-jvm") version "1.0.1"
}
```
